summary: This study investigates the role of estrogen and its receptors, ESR1 and GPER1, in regulating intraocular pressure (IOP) through trabecular meshwork (TM) and Schlemm's canal (SC) endothelial cells. The study aims to determine how estrogen signaling affects IOP levels and primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG) risk by modulating the turnover of extracellular matrix in the TM and nitric oxide (NO) signaling in the SC. The researchers propose to use tissue-specific knockout mice and in vitro primary cell culture models to investigate the effects of ESR1 and GPER1 on IOP regulation.
